description: This file declares classes and methods for remote secure hardware provisioning and presentation proxies used in Android's identity hardware abstraction layer. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to secure hardware operations.

classes.name: RemoteSecureHardwareProvisioningProxy
classes.description: Implements secure hardware provisioning operations using libEmbeddedIC, providing methods for initialization, credential creation, and entry management.

classes.name: RemoteSecureHardwarePresentationProxy
classes.description: Implements secure hardware presentation operations, including key generation, authentication, and entry retrieval, using libEmbeddedIC.

classes.name: RemoteSecureHardwareProxyFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of provisioning and presentation proxies.

methods.name: RemoteSecureHardwareProvisioningProxy()
methods.description: Constructor for the provisioning proxy class.

methods.name: virtual ~RemoteSecureHardwareProvisioningProxy()
methods.description: Destructor for the provisioning proxy class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning proxy, optionally for testing credentials.

methods.name: initializeForUpdate
methods.description: Initializes the proxy for updating credentials with specified document type and encrypted keys.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the provisioning proxy.

methods.name: createCredentialKey
methods.description: Creates a credential key, returning a public key certificate.

methods.name: startPersonalization
methods.description: Starts personalization with specified access control profiles and document type.

methods.name: addAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile, returning a MAC.

methods.name: beginAddEntry
methods.description: Begins adding an entry with specified access control profile IDs.

methods.name: addEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an entry, returning encrypted content.

methods.name: finishAddingEntries
methods.description: Completes adding entries, returning a signature.

methods.name: finishGetCredentialData
methods.description: Completes credential data retrieval, returning encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: RemoteSecureHardwarePresentationProxy()
methods.description: Constructor for the presentation proxy class.

methods.name: virtual ~RemoteSecureHardwarePresentationProxy()
methods.description: Destructor for the presentation proxy class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the presentation proxy with credentials and document type.

methods.name: generateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a signing key pair, returning public key and signing key blob.

methods.name: createEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral private key.

methods.name: createAuthChallenge
methods.description: Creates an authentication challenge.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntries
methods.description: Starts retrieval of entries.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets an authentication token with various parameters.

methods.name: pushReaderCert
methods.description: Pushes a reader certificate.

methods.name: validateAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Validates an access control profile.

methods.name: validateRequestMessage
methods.description: Validates a request message.

methods.name: calcMacKey
methods.description: Calculates a MAC key based on session data.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Starts retrieval of an entry value.

methods.name: retrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Retrieves an entry value.

methods.name: finishRetrieval
methods.description: Completes retrieval process.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a credential.

methods.name: proveOwnership
methods.description: Proves ownership of a credential.

methods.name: RemoteSecureHardwareProxyFactory()
methods.description: Constructor for the proxy factory.

methods.name: virtual ~RemoteSecureHardwareProxyFactory()
methods.description: Destructor for the proxy factory.

methods.name: createProvisioningProxy
methods.description: Creates a new provisioning proxy instance.

methods.name: createPresentationProxy
methods.description: Creates a new presentation proxy instance.
